slides.visual: Minimal title composition: a precise isometric mechanical bracket and a short version lineage, one quiet focal illustration.

slides.title: 持续人机 CAD 编辑
slides.subtitle: A changing shared project
slides.visual: One horizontal project timeline with alternating human and AI edits, a clear absence interval, and a return point.

slides.title: 旧结论为何失效
slides.subtitle: An unchanged part can be unsafe
slides.visual: A paired mechanical illustration: same plate and insertion cylinder before and after an obstacle moves into the insertion region. Highlight only the obstacle and collision region. Label this a synthetic example.

slides.title: 最接近的相关工作
slides.subtitle: Closest prior work
slides.keywords: CAD editing / Agent memory / Our question
slides.visual: Flat two-column literature map with TraceCAD and MUSE on one side, Concord, TRACE and Invalidation Contracts on the other. A small connecting region says CAD query validity. Mark research overlap explicitly; no claim that memory or long-horizon CAD is new.

slides.title: CAD 特有的有效性问题
slides.subtitle: CAD-specific validity
slides.visual: One large exploded assembly drawing with three restrained annotations showing a scoped empty region, two instances of one component, and a dimension tolerance. Readable minimal labels.

slides.title: 研究问题与边界
slides.subtitle: Research questions and scope
slides.visual: One dominant query/evidence schematic. State research question in a short phrase: Which old evidence still supports the next action? Small note: Candidate contribution, not proven novelty.

slides.title: 任务一：持续编辑评测
slides.subtitle: Benchmark design
slides.visual: Two aligned horizontal lanes. Top lane evaluates identical frozen checkpoints. Bottom lane inherits each system output before external semantic edits. Show plan: 20 scenes x 6 variants; do not imply completed experiments.

slides.title: 任务二：证据维护方法
slides.subtitle: Evidence maintenance
slides.visual: A clean left-to-right technical pipeline. CAD query creates source-bound evidence, a validity guard chooses retain, revalidate or unknown, then the agent replans and commits against the current version. Short stage labels, no UI cards.

slides.title: 谓词有效与数值新鲜度
slides.subtitle: Predicate validity vs exact values
slides.visual: One scientific geometry illustration of two separated cubes. An old exact distance is crossed out as stale while a conservative lower bound still supports clearance >= 3 mm. Add short note: Established bound; proposed use in evidence maintenance. No invented theorem.

slides.title: 已有基础与启动路径
slides.subtitle: Feasibility and pilot
slides.visual: One system architecture drawing linking the existing browser, agent harness, version store and kernel query worker. Distinguish solid strokes for existing infrastructure and dashed strokes for proposed evidence guard. Small note: Method efficacy untested.

slides.title: 评价与预期关键结果
slides.subtitle: Evaluation and expected outcomes
slides.keywords: Success / Stale use / Retention / Total cost
slides.visual: A conceptual evaluation layout with four clear metric labels and a simple comparison protocol. Mention strong baselines: Fresh queries, Hash, AABB, Concord, Contracts. Explicitly label Planned evaluation. NO quantitative result bars, no fabricated curves, no rankings.

slides.title: 贡献、计划与讨论
slides.subtitle: Contributions and discussion
slides.keywords: Benchmark + Method / Pilot first / Go or no-go
slides.visual: A restrained staged research timeline and a final open scientific question: When is evidence sufficient to act? Show failure conditions as well as intended contributions. No claim of guaranteed publication.
